byRule.key: WIN-005 Account added to privileged group
NET-002 Network brute force against auth service
WIN-003 Successful logon after brute force

rules.name: Port scan detected
rules.description: A single source probed many distinct ports on one host, typical of reconnaissance (nmap, masscan).

rules.name: Network brute force against auth service
rules.description: High rate of connections from one source to an authentication service (SSH, FTP, RDP, SMB...).
rules.logic: count(flows to auth port) >= 20 by (src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port) within 2m

rules.name: Denial-of-service flood
rules.description: Abnormally high flow rate against a single service.

rules.name: Repeated failed logons (brute force)
rules.description: Five or more failed logons from the same source within two minutes.

rules.name: Password spraying
rules.description: Failed logons against ten or more distinct accounts from one source within 15 minutes.

rules.name: Successful logon after brute force
rules.description: A source that just failed repeatedly then logged on successfully: likely compromised credentials.
rules.logic: WIN-001 burst by IpAddress, followed by EventID 4624 from same IpAddress + account within 10m

rules.name: Suspicious PowerShell execution
rules.description: PowerShell started with encoded commands, hidden window or download cradle.
rules.logic: EventID 4688/Sysmon 1 where Image ~ powershell and CommandLine has >= 2 obfuscation/download indicators

rules.name: Account added to privileged group
rules.description: A member was added to Administrators / Domain Admins or similar.
rules.logic: EventID 4728/4732/4756 to privileged group; +20 if member created (4720) within 60m

rules.name: Security audit log cleared
rules.description: The Windows Security log was cleared, which destroys forensic evidence.
rules.mitreTechniqueName: Indicator Removal: Clear Windows Event Logs

rules.name: Anomalous network behaviour (ML)
rules.description: Isolation Forest trained on benign CIC-IDS2017 traffic flagged a cluster of flows no signature rule explains.
rules.logic: anomaly_score >= model threshold, >= 5 flows by (src_ip, dst_ip) within 5m, not covered by a rule

alert.title: Account administrator compromised? Logon succeeded after 14 failures from 10.0.5.66
alert.description: 10.0.5.66 failed 14 times then logged on as administrator on FIN-SRV01 (logon type 3).
alert.summary:
10.0.5.66 failed 14 times then logged on as administrator on FIN-SRV01 (logon type 3).

ATT&CK: T1078 Valid Accounts (Initial Access).
Risk 100/100 (CRITICAL), raised by privilegedAccount +10, volume +2, criticalAsset +10, correlation +10.

Next steps:
- Treat as compromised credentials: disable or reset the account now.
- Isolate the host the account logged on to and review its process/network activity.
- Scope lateral movement from that host in the following hours.

playbook: Treat as compromised credentials: disable or reset the account now.
Isolate the host the account logged on to and review its process/network activity.
Scope lateral movement from that host in the following hours.

activity.note: Disabled administrator on FIN-SRV01, isolating host for forensics.
